set.body:
Source: upper-layer Site/pilot spool design review and the existing AtomicFiles extraction finding.

Problem:
Digesting, bounded reads, secure temporary writes, and atomic publication are duplicated. A shared-filesystem worker queue additionally needs an atomic claim operation without importing spool semantics into scala-slurm.

Scope and acceptance:
- Build the narrow AtomicFiles substrate established by the staging/publication remediation.
- Add claim(from, to) with typed Claimed, AlreadyClaimed, SourceMissing, AtomicMoveUnavailable, and bounded I/O failure outcomes.
- Require same-filesystem atomic semantics, non-symlink regular-file checks, private permissions, and no silent fallback to copy/delete.
- Specify target-exists and crash-window behavior precisely.
- Add multi-contender, symlink, missing-source, unsupported-filesystem, and restart tests.
- Expose only the filesystem primitive; queue entries, claim leases, recovery policy, pools, and spools remain above this library.
set.title: P6f.26: Add a typed atomic file-claim primitive
